newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech launches Internet access service.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech launches Internet access service.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Thursday its dial-up Internet access service, called Ameritech.net, is now available in the Chicago, Detroit and Cleveland areas.

The company said its Ameritech.net service offers local telephone numbers and network enhancements that will reduce connection problems like disconnects and busy signals. The service costs $8.95 a month for 10 hours of use, or $19.95 a month for unlimited use, Ameritech said. Customers may also pay an annual fee of $189, a cost of $15.75 per month.
Ameritech is a regional telephone service provider.
Its shares were trading down 1/4 Thursday at 57-7/8.
